notes.es: Los dos primeros vertidos (40 % del agua) definen dulzor y acidez; los tres siguientes (60 %) la fuerza. Variante para tueste medio: 88 °C. Con tueste claro la fuente usa 93 °C y con oscuro 83 °C, empezando con dos vertidos.
notes.en: The first two pours (40 % of the water) set sweetness and acidity; the next three (60 %) set strength. Medium roast variant: 88 °C. For a light roast the source uses 93 °C, and for a dark roast 83 °C, starting with two pours.

instruction.es: Retira el gotero aunque quede agua.
instruction.en: Remove the dripper even if water remains.

instruction.en: Add 100 g (total 250 g) in slow circles.

notes.en: Kalita Wave with water at about 96 °C (205 °F). The guide does not fix how many pulses go in the last pour. It finishes draining between 2 min 45 s and 3 min.

instruction.es: Remueve suave para que no quede café seco.

instruction.es: Remueve muy suave 3 veces adelante y atrás.
instruction.en: Stir very gently 3 times back and forth.

instruction.es: Saca el aire y pon la tapa con 2 filtros.
instruction.en: Squeeze out the air and put on the cap with 2 filters.

instruction.es: Da la vuelta y presiona enseguida.
Gira la jarra suavemente para enfriar.
instruction.en: Gently swirl the server to cool it.

instruction.en: Flip and press: about 60 g of concentrate comes out.

instruction.es: Enfría hasta unos 60 °C removiendo y trasvasando.
instruction.en: Cool to about 60 °C by stirring and decanting.
